name: CloudHQ Querétaro campus (QRO)
status_note: Six-building campus (6 × 48 MW IT = 288 MW) on ~52 ha; investment raised to ~$6B and planned power to ~1,000 MW (Oct 2026). Work so far reported on the substation and transmission lines.

announced.note: CloudHQ announces $4.8B plan for six Querétaro data centers (Mexico News Daily, 25 Sep 2025); project first floated in 2022.

sources.title: CloudHQ announces US $4.8B plan to build 6 data centers in Querétaro
CloudHQ raises Mexico data centre investment to US$6 billion as power capacity quadruples
CloudHQ breaks ground on power infra for Mexican datacenter campus

review_notes: Groundbreaking on power infrastructure reported (BNamericas, undated; page blocked): date it and decide whether that counts as construction start. Range: 288 MW IT vs ~1,000 MW planned power.
